Parameter.name: APPLICATION
Parameter.Description: Class name of application this page belongs to.

XData.name: Style
XData.Description: This Style block contains page-specific CSS style definitions.
XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">
 body { font-family: arial; }

     table.tpTable caption{
       background: transparent;
       font-size: 1em;
       font-weight: bold;
       text-align: left;
       border: none;
     }

    /* even rows */
     .tpEven { color: black; background: #ebf3ff; }
    
    /* odd rows */
     .tpOdd { color: black; background: white; }

    /* this is a selected row */
     table.tpTable tr.tpSelected { background: #3d80df; color: white; }
   
    /* hover for odd and even rows */
     tr.tpOdd:hover,tr.tpEven:hover { 
        background-color: #3d80df; 
        color: #ffffff; }
  
    /* table header style */
    table.tpTable th {
        border-right: 1px solid gray;
        border-bottom: 1px solid gray;
        background: #C5D6D6;
        color: black;
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 2px;
        overflow: hidden;
     }

    /* selected column header (th) */
     table.tpTable th.tpHdrSelected { background: #3d80df; }

    /* filter layout */
     table.tpFilterLayout td { border: none; background: #C5D6D6; }

/*fieldSet styles*/
.fieldset{
     background: #FFFFFF;
     border: solid 1px #C5D6D6;
     color: #000000;
     font-size: 1em;
     font-family: arial;
}
.modalGroup{
     background: #C5D6D6;
     border: solid 1px #C5D6D6;
     color: #000000;
     font-size: 1em;
     font-family: arial;
}
.datacombo
{
	 border:none
}
/*text control styles*/
.text
{  
    font-size: .8em;
    font-family: arial;
    color: #000000;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 1px;
    border: solid 1px grey;
    margin-right: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
    height: 25px;
}
.Navigator {
	color:green;
	padding:5px;
	font-family:Verdana;
	font-size:15px;
}


</style>

XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%"> <hgroup align="left" valign="top" > <vgroup align="left" valign="top" >
<label id="infoLbl" align="left"/> <spacer height="10"/>
<fieldSet id="filter" hidden="false" legend=" Filter: " width="100%"> <hgroup> <dataCombo id="nmsp" align="left" label="Namespace" dropdownHeight="80" editable="false" sql="select Namespace from IHC_ITF_SrcCtrlPkg.Namespaces order by Namespace" onchange="zenPage.repopulateTable();"/> <spacer width="20"/> <dataCombo id="env" align="left" label="Environment" dropdownHeight="80" editable="false" sql="select Environment from IHC_ITF_SrcCtrlPkg.Environment" onchange="zenPage.repopulateTable();"/> <spacer width="20"/> <dataCombo id="comp" align="left" label="Component" dropdownHeight="100" width="400" dropdownWidth="400" editable="false" size="60" maxRows="800" OnCreateResultSet="CreateCompRS" onchange="zenPage.repopulateTable();"/>
<spacer width="20"/> <button caption="Clear" onclick="zenPage.clearFilter();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet> <spacer height="20"/> <fieldSet id="display" hidden="false" legend=" Display: " >
<radioSet id="rId" name="QueryType" value="I" displayList="Component Implementation, Classes Implementation" valueList="I,C" onclick="zenPage.repopulateTable()"/>
</fieldSet> <spacer height="20"/> <tableNavigatorBar enclosingClass="Navigator" align="left" height="50" id="tableNavigator" tablePaneId="deployments" />
<tablePane width="80%" id="deployments" pageSize="25" maxRows="1000" showRowNumbers="true" showZebra="true" useSnapshot="true" OnCreateResultSet="CreateRS" valueColumn="ComponentName" ondblclick="zenPage.displayImplInfo();">
</tablePane>
</vgroup> </hgroup> </pane>

Method.name: repopulateTable
displayImplInfo
setSessionValues
Method.Implementation:
set qt = %page.%GetValueById("rId") set compNm = %page.%GetValueById("comp") set nmSp = %page.%GetValueById("nmsp") set envr = %page.%GetValueById("env")
set %session.Data("QueryType") = qt set %session.Data("Component") = compNm set %session.Data("Namespace") = nmSp set %session.Data("Environment") = envr
return $$$OK
